parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)(1-\sin\theta\cos\theta)\equiv\sin^3\theta+\cos^3\theta$. Guidance: Accept abbreviations $s$ and $c$. LHS $=\sin\theta+\cos\theta-\sin^2\theta\cos\theta-\sin\theta\cos^2\theta$ — M1. Guidance: Expansion. $=\sin\theta(1-\cos^2\theta)+\cos\theta(1-\sin^2\theta)$ or $(s+c-c(1-c^2)-s(1-s^2))$ — M1A1. Guidance: Uses identity twice. Everything correct. AG. Uses $\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta=1\to\sin^3\theta+\cos^3\theta$ (RHS). Guidance: Or from RHS: M1 for use of trig ID twice. Or: LHS $=(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)(\sin^2\theta+\cos^2\theta-\sin\theta\cos\theta)$ — M1. Guidance: M1 for factorisation. $=\sin^3\theta+\sin\theta\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta\cos\theta+\cos\theta\sin^2\theta+\cos^3\theta-\sin\theta\cos^2\theta=\sin^3\theta+\cos^3\theta$ — M1A1. Total: 3.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)(1-\sin\theta\cos\theta)=3\cos^3\theta\to\sin^3\theta=2\cos^3\theta$ — M1. $\to\tan^3\theta=2\to\theta=51.6^\circ$ or $231.6^\circ$ (only) — A1 A1FT. Guidance: Uses $\tan^3=\sin^3\div\cos^3$. A1 CAO, A1FT, $180+$ their acute angle. $\tan^3\theta=0$ gets M0. Total: 3.
